class.name: LandscapeSpline3D
class.brief_description: A road, river, stream or lake following a spline, modifying the terrain of a [Landscape3D].
class.description: A smooth curve through control points, similar to the landscape splines and water bodies of Unreal Engine. Each point has its own width, depth, banking and flow speed, interpolated smoothly along the curve. - A mesh is extruded along the curve (road surface with skirts, water surface of rivers and streams) or fills it (flat surface of lakes). It is split in chunks of [member chunk_length] that are culled and LODed separately, only built near the camera and hidden beyond [member visibility_range]. - The terrain of the [Landscape3D] ancestor is modified under the spline: flattened road bed, channel carved below the water with its banks, or lake basin. A material layer can also be painted ([member paint_layer]). The terrain is modified non-destructively: the terrain of the storage tiles under splines is kept in a base layer of the [LandscapeData], and the splines are composited on top of it, in the order of their [member terrain_priority]. Moving or deleting a spline restores the terrain it covered, and sculpting or painting under splines edits the base layer. Only the parts of the splines that changed are applied again (see [method LandscapeData.get_spline_records]). At runtime, splines aren't composited again unless they change, and brushes modify the terrain directly. Points are drawn and edited with the Splines tab of the Landscape dock: select them in the viewport and move them with the transform gizmo, and drag the handles on their sides to change the width. Water and road surfaces use [LandscapeWaterMaterial] and [LandscapeRoadMaterial] by default (see [method get_default_material]).

method.name: add_point
method.description: Adds a point at [param position] (local space). If [param index] is [code]-1[/code], the point is added at the end, otherwise it is inserted before the point at [param index]. The attributes of the new point take the default values ([member width], [member depth], [member flow_speed]).

method.name: apply_type_defaults
method.description: Sets the typical dimensions and settings of the [member type] of the spline: width, depth, flow speed, mesh density, terrain falloff and priority, paint and visibility range. The attributes of the existing points are reset to the new defaults.

method.name: clear_points
method.description: Removes all points.

method.name: create_curve
method.description: Returns a [Curve3D] following the spline exactly (Bézier control points computed from the curve), e.g. to move objects along a road with [PathFollow3D]. The tilt of the points is the banking of the road.

method.name: create_mesh
method.description: Returns the whole mesh of the spline (every chunk, full detail) in a single surface, e.g. to bake navigation meshes or to export it.

method.name: get_closest_distance
method.description: Returns the distance along the spline (in meters, from the first point) of the point of the curve closest to [param local_position].

method.name: get_default_material
method.description: Returns the shared material used when [member material] isn't set: a [LandscapeRoadMaterial] for roads, a [LandscapeWaterMaterial] for rivers, streams and lakes.

method.name: get_length
method.description: Returns the length of the spline in meters (local space).

method.name: get_point_count
method.description: Returns the number of points.

method.name: get_point_depth
method.description: Returns the depth of the channel below the water at the point [param index].

method.name: get_point_flow_speed
method.description: Returns the speed of the water at the point [param index], in meters per second.

method.name: get_point_position
method.description: Returns the position of the point [param index] (local space).

method.name: get_point_tilt
method.description: Returns the banking of the road at the point [param index], in radians.

method.name: get_point_width
method.description: Returns the width at the point [param index].

method.name: get_spline_id
method.description: Returns the unique identifier of the spline, used by [member LandscapeData.spline_records] to find the terrain it modified. It is random for new splines, and regenerated when a spline with the same identifier is already registered (duplicated nodes).

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns statistics about the spline: - [code]samples[/code]: number of cross sections of the tessellated curve. - [code]length[/code]: length in meters. - [code]chunks[/code]: number of mesh chunks. - [code]chunks_built[/code]: number of chunks built (the others are too far from the camera). - [code]vertices[/code] and [code]triangles[/code]: size of the built chunks (full detail).

method.name: get_surface_info
method.description: Returns information about the surface of the spline at the horizontal position of [param global_position], or an empty dictionary if the spline has less than 2 points: - [code]inside[/code]: [code]true[/code] if the position is over the road, the water of the river or stream, or inside the lake. - [code]position[/code], [code]height[/code] and [code]normal[/code]: point of the surface (road or water) at this position, in global space. - [code]distance[/code]: distance along the spline of the closest point of the curve. - [code]lateral[/code]: signed distance to the curve (positive on the right), or for lakes, the distance to the shore (negative inside). - [code]width[/code] and [code]depth[/code]: width and depth at the closest point. - [code]flow[/code]: velocity of the water of rivers and streams, in global space. [codeblock] var info = $River.get_surface_info(player.global_position) if info.inside and player.global_position.y < info.height: player.velocity += info.flow * delta [/codeblock]

method.name: get_tessellated_points
method.description: Returns the points of the tessellated curve (local space), spaced by at most [member sample_spacing].

method.name: is_point_in_water
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param global_position] is below the surface of the water of a river, stream or lake. Always returns [code]false[/code] for roads.

method.name: level_lake_to_shore
method.description: Moves the node (the water level of the lake) to the lowest point of the shore minus [param margin], so that the water doesn't overflow its basin. Uses the terrain without the splines.

method.name: make_downhill
method.description: Lowers the points of rivers and streams so that each point is at least [param min_drop] × horizontal distance lower than the previous one: the water always flows downhill, from the first point to the last one.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds the mesh and applies the spline to the terrain again.

method.name: remove_point
method.description: Removes the point [param index].

method.name: reverse
method.description: Reverses the order of the points (the direction of the flow of rivers and streams). The banking of the points is reversed too.

method.name: sample_position
method.description: Returns the position (local space) of the curve at [param distance] meters from the first point.

method.name: sample_transform
method.description: Returns the frame (local space) of the curve at [param distance] meters from the first point: [code]basis.x[/code] points to the right, [code]basis.y[/code] up (banked for roads) and [code]-basis.z[/code] forward, like a [Camera3D] or a [PathFollow3D] looking along the spline.

method.name: set_point_depth
method.description: Sets the depth of the channel below the water at the point [param index].

method.name: set_point_flow_speed
method.description: Sets the speed of the water at the point [param index], in meters per second.

method.name: set_point_position
method.description: Sets the position of the point [param index] (local space).

method.name: set_point_tilt
method.description: Sets the banking of the road at the point [param index], in radians (positive raises the right side).

method.name: set_point_width
method.description: Sets the width at the point [param index].

method.name: set_spline_id
method.description: Sets the unique identifier of the spline. See [method get_spline_id].

method.name: snap_to_terrain
method.description: Puts the points on the terrain, [param offset] meters above it. The terrain without the splines is used, so the result doesn't depend on the current deformation. For lakes, calls [method level_lake_to_shore].

members.member: Height of the banks of rivers, streams and lakes above the water: the terrain beside the water is raised to it if it is lower (only with [member terrain_raise]).
If [code]true[/code], the mesh casts shadows. Disabled by default: roads lie on the terrain and water doesn't need shadows.
Shape of the bottom of the channel of rivers and streams: [code]1[/code] is V-shaped, higher values are flatter with steeper sides.
Length of the chunks of the mesh. Each chunk is a separate instance, culled and LODed separately. Lakes are split in blocks of 32 × 32 cells instead.
If [code]true[/code], the last point is connected to the first one (e.g. a ring road). Lakes are always closed.
Depth of new points (depth of the channel below the water of rivers and streams), and depth of lakes below their water level.
Speed of the water of new points, in meters per second.
Maximum distance between the vertices across the mesh of roads, rivers and streams. Also the size of the cells of the lake surface.
LOD bias of the mesh chunks. Higher values keep the detailed mesh further away.
The material of the mesh. If not set, the shared material of [method get_default_material] is used.
If [code]false[/code], no mesh is built: the spline only modifies the terrain (e.g. dirt paths painted on the terrain, or a flattened area).
Width of the transition of the painted layer.
The layer of the [Landscape3D] painted under the spline (e.g. dirt under roads, mud or gravel in river beds), or [code]-1[/code] to paint nothing.
Amount of noise breaking the edges of the painted layer.
Weight of the painted layer.
Distance the painted layer extends beyond the edges of the spline (negative values paint a narrower area). For lakes, beyond the shore.
Depth of the channel below the water at each point.
Speed of the water at each point, in meters per second. Faster water has more foam and ripples.
Banking of the road at each point, in radians.
Width at each point: width of the road, or of the water at the banks.

The control points of the spline (local space). The curve passes through them (centripetal Catmull-Rom spline). Rivers and streams flow from the first point to the last one. The points of lakes define the shore: only their horizontal position is used, the water level is the height of the node.
The render layers of the mesh.
Maximum distance between the cross sections of the tessellated curve. The curve is also subdivided in curves.
Width of the slope from the shore of lakes to their bottom.
Depth of the vertical skirts along the edges of roads, hiding the gaps between the road and the terrain.
If [code]true[/code], the terrain of the [Landscape3D] ancestor is modified under the spline.
Length of the transition to the terrain beyond the ends of open roads, rivers and streams.
Width of the transition to the terrain on the sides of the spline (beyond the banks for water).
If [code]true[/code], the terrain above the spline is lowered (cuttings of roads, channels of rivers).
Distance the road bed is lowered below the road mesh, avoiding z-fighting.
Order in which the splines are applied to the terrain: splines with a higher priority are applied later, over the others (e.g. a road over a river for a ford or a bridge ramp).
If [code]true[/code], the terrain below the spline is raised (embankments of roads, banks of rivers).
How much the terrain is modified, from [code]0[/code] (not at all) to [code]1[/code].
The kind of spline: it sets the terrain profile, the mesh and the default material. Call [method apply_type_defaults] to also use the typical dimensions of this kind of spline.
Distance beyond which the chunks of the mesh are hidden (and faded out before), and not built. [code]0[/code] means always visible.
Distance the water surface extends under the banks of rivers and streams, or beyond the shore of lakes, so that no gap appears between the water and the terrain.
Width of new points.

constants.constant: A road: the mesh is extruded along the spline (with skirts on its edges), the terrain is flattened under it to the banked road surface.
A river: the water surface follows the spline, a channel is carved below it with banks on its sides.
A stream: like a river, narrower, shallower and faster.
A lake: the points define its shore (closed spline), the water surface is flat at the height of the node, a basin is carved below it.
